caption: The drawing is a technical, architectural sketch done in black ink on a yellowed, off-white background. It displays three different views of a rectangular table: a top view (at the top left), a side view (at the bottom left), and an end view (at the bottom right). The top view shows the table as a rectangle measuring 32 inches by 17 1/2 inches, with inner lines representing a central circle and cross braces, plus a double border, and a small handle on the right side indicating a drawer. The side view shows a table with straight legs connected at the bottom by a scalloped apron and a decorative turn in the center, a thick tabletop roughly 1 inch thick, a shallow drawer below the tabletop, and overall height of about 29 inches. The end view shows the same table, with the drawer pulled out to reveal a decorative handle, and the table's side apron detailed below, plus the tabletop shown with one leaf extended upward. Measurement indications in red ink annotate the drawing, listing lengths in inches for all visible dimensions, and there is typewritten text within a box marking the object as "TABLE PARLOR OF THE RUSSEL HOUSE. BROOKLYN MUSEUM,” along with handwritten notes and identification codes in red and blue ink at the top right. The drawing is laid out with visible ruler margins at the sides.
title: Table
